trans-unit.source: Shows the WebAuthn/FIDO2 passkeys registered for this backend user. Administrators can revoke individual passkeys or unlock rate-limited accounts.

Passkeys provide passwordless authentication using biometric sensors (fingerprint, face recognition) or hardware security keys. Each passkey is bound to a specific device and cannot be phished or reused across sites. Administrators can revoke compromised passkeys without resetting the user's password.
